name: Non-Wilderness bears
accessNote: Non-Wilderness bears for Turael, Spria, and Mazchna tasks: the Fremennik Province woods just outside Rellekka hold about 10 grizzly bears, with more in the Kebos Lowlands south of Mount Quidamortem; black bears cluster around the Mind Altar and Varrock south-east mine. Grizzly bear cubs are in Isafdar (partial Regicide required). Multicombat, cannon, and safespot status are not documented on the wiki and are left conservative (false).
